title: The price answer for the stand: what may a team member say when asked about price or terms?
detail: WS-137 plan v2 (Indi's): one or two sentences agreed by Dinis go on the stand's answer sheet, so nobody improvises. Nothing goes on it without Dinis's words.
recommend: Dinis gives one or two sentences, for example: pricing comes from Dinis; a first policy starts with one of your agents
options: No price talk at all: 'Dinis will follow up'
